# Claims

1. A wearable signaling device comprising:
   a flexible band;
   a light emitter mounted on the band;
   a motion sensor configured to detect a hand gesture; and
   a controller that activates the light emitter in response to the hand gesture.

2. The wearable signaling device of claim 1, wherein the light emitter is an LED array.

3. The wearable signaling device of claim 1, further comprising a battery housed in the band.

4. The wearable signaling device of claim 1, wherein the housing encloses the controller.

5. The wearable signaling device of claim 4, wherein the housing is substantially rigid.

6. The wearable signaling device of claim 1, wherein the band is adjustable.

7. The wearable signaling device of claim 1, wherein the controller reads the the sensor at a sampling rate of at least 50 Hz.

8. The wearable signaling device of claim 1, further comprising a dampening member between the band and the light emitter.

9. The wearable signaling device of claim 1, further comprising a signal processing module configured to classify the motion.

10. A method of signaling a turn, comprising:
   detecting a hand gesture with a motion sensor worn on a wrist; and
   activating a light emitter on a flexible band in response to the hand gesture.

11. The wearable signaling device of claim 1, further comprising a haptic motor that vibrates to confirm the hand gesture.

12. The method of claim 10, further comprising transmitting a signal to a helmet.

13. The wearable signaling device of claim 9, wherein the signal processing module distinguishes a left-turn gesture from a right-turn gesture.

14. The wearable signaling device of claim 13, wherein the light emitter displays an amber arrow.

15. The wearable signaling device of claim 14, wherein the amber arrow points in the direction of the turn.

16. A charging dock for the wearable signaling device of claim 1.

17. The charging dock of claim 16, comprising an inductive coil.

18. The charging dock of claim 17, comprising a status light.

19. The method of claim 10, wherein the hand gesture is a raised arm.

20. The method of claim 10, wherein the light emitter flashes at a rate of 2 Hz.
